title: Token Mosaic Initiative: cost harmonization for batching, cache, and quantization
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Create a coordinated initiative to harmonize batching tiers, KV prefix caching policies, and quantization profiles across high-volume customer routes to achieve a sustainable 18-25% unit-cost reduction without degrading core quality SLAs. This ticket tracks milestones, experiment matrix, rollout gates, and post-rollout monitoring/contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Define experiment matrix covering at least 12 representative routes across chat, completion, and embeddings
Run A/B trials with gating checks and statistical significance thresholds for latency and inference quality (n>=10k requests per variant)
Validated set of 3 quantization profiles with documented degradation envelopes and switchback safe guards
Operational rollout plan with canary bands (1%, 10%, 50%) and automated rollback criteria tied to Console alerts
Dashboard telemetry: per-route token cost, P50/P95 latency delta, and human-eval quality delta tracked for 30 days post-rollout
milestones: M1: Experiment matrix finalized and infra work scoped (2026-03-15)
M3: Internal field trials (canary) across 4 pilot routes (2026-04-20)
M4: Full staged rollout to non-enterprise traffic with rollback hooks (2026-05-15)
M5: Post-rollout validation and handbook publication (2026-06-01)
recent_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff workshop with Serving, Infra, and Evaluations. Agreed on primary KPIs and significance thresholds.
2026-03-05: Eng spike completed for lightweight per-route batching tiers. Proof-of-concept shows 12% token savings on toy route.
2026-03-09: Design & Docs owner assigned to write rollout runbook; security requested KMS integration plan for quant artifacts.
2026-03-11: PM review: narrowed pilot routes to four (chat-fast, chat-rich-context, embeddings-bulk, rating-rerank).
experiment_registry: EXP-2026-03-01-batch-tiering: compare static small/medium/large batch windows
EXP-2026-03-07-prefetch-kv-ttl: test adaptive KV TTL strategy vs fixed 5s/30s
EXP-2026-03-10-quant-skyline: evaluate 3 quant profiles (q4_0, q4_1-slim, q2_8aggressive) with fallback policy
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Shadow runs and diffs only (2 weeks)
Phase 1: Canary 1% traffic with synthetic QA traffic and alerting (1 week)
Phase 2: Canary 10% with live traffic, human eval checkpoints (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Ramp to 50% then to 100% with staged region rollout and cost-sla contract sign-off
risks: Quality regression in long-context conversations due to aggressive quant profile
Increased P95 latency spikes when batching windows exceed tail-latency thresholds
Cache pollution causing cross-customer prefix leakage if isolation not strictly enforced
Unanticipated interactions with Dedicated autoscaling policies leading to capacity thrash
mitigations: Require human-eval sets covering long-context edge cases for any quant profile promoted to canary
Implement adaptive batching window with hard P95 latency cap; auto-shrink on violation
KV cache namespacing enforced by tenant id and automated audit logs; penetration test scheduled
Coordinate with Dedicated SRE to temporarily pin autoscaler during canaries; add capacity buffer
decisions: Adopt three-tier batching (low/medium/high) keyed by route SLA and expected token distribution
Make cache TTL adaptive based on 95th-percentile reuse window; default conservative 5s for now
Use conservative quant profile q4_1-slim as canary candidate and keep q2_8aggressive for internal testing only
open_questions: What is the minimum sample size per route to claim no degradation at 90% confidence?
Do we expose batching tier controls to customers or keep them under Redwood-managed policies?
How should billing attribution look if a request spans multiple models with mixed quant profiles?
notes_for_engineering: ENG owners: add per-request metadata flags so Console can correlate token-savings with prompt shape
Instrument sampling for human-eval attachments; include model logits where possible for deeper regressions
Create a lightweight rollback API that can flip quant profile per-model in <30s
communication_plan: Weekly sync: Wednesdays 10am PT with leads
Biweekly demo: show experiment diffs and human-eval summaries to broader audience
Status bulletin: post to #pm-initiative-updates after each milestone
postmortem_plan: If rollback triggered: 24h incident review with RCA and mitigation ticket within 3 business days
30-day cost/quality retrospective and playbook updates to be published to Confluence
